title: Keith house's crown band packed closer, as the 1888 photograph shows
items: 1808 Prairie (1904): the diamond-pointed band under the parapet now stands its points 0.28 m apart along each row, not 0.34 m, so the band reads as close-packed stone the way the 1888 Inland Architect photograph, the 1948 and the 1967 views show it.
Three more of the house's sixteen photographs now read as matching the model, eight in all.
